reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Expand on compose function error messaging if we see there is an issue with the composite resource", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Error messages for compose functions are more detailed when the composite resource has an issue; no operational consequence is stated.

proposed.statement: Compose function error messages are expanded when an issue with the composite resource is detected; no operational impact stated.
